theme_strategy.rationale: Indian University Study Portal (SKMU Dumka - AEC Hindi). Academic reading and deep study requires warm parchment light mode with an optional crisp reading night-mode toggle. Emulates rich editorial textbook printing with warm terracotta, deep indigo/saffron accents, and crisp Devanagari typography.

surfaces.name: hero
surfaces.guarantee: scrim: linear-gradient(135deg, #2A170A 0%, #1A1F2C 100%) with dark backdrop tint

typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif

entry_surfaces./: split academic hero — SKMU Dumka AEC Hindi curriculum positioning + exam scheme pill left, interactive study overview with unit cards & live progress widget right
entry_surfaces./ikai/1: unit header with syllabus outcome banner + 5 comprehensive writing modules (Letter types + Essay topics) with progress checklists
entry_surfaces./ikai/2: grammar master dashboard — 12 core grammar topics categorized with search filter, difficulty badges, and quick-read counters
entry_surfaces./vishay/:slug: editorial textbook reading screen — left quick-jump outline, central rich content renderer with tables/examples/exam tips, bottom previous/next topic pagination + mark as completed button
entry_surfaces./abhyas: interactive MCQ quiz suite — topic selector bar + dynamic question runner with instant explanation reveal, score gauge and review mode
entry_surfaces./pariksha: official exam scheme blueprint — 50 marks Group A & B breakdown, passing marks rulebook, revealable Group A 1-mark question bank + Group B 15-mark model answers

grids_and_layouts.hero_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12 items-center py-10 lg:py-16
grids_and_layouts.reading_content: lg:col-span-9 bg-white border border-[#E7DFD5] rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-10 shadow-sm

motion.page_transitions: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: 'easeOut' }}
motion.respect_reduced_motion: Wrap animations with `prefers-reduced-motion` checks or use CSS micro-transitions (e.g. `transition-transform duration-200`)

accessibility.data_testid_convention: All buttons, navigation links, filters, question choices, answer reveal buttons, progress toggles, search bars MUST have explicit data-testid in kebab-case (e.g., 'nav-home-link', 'btn-mark-read', 'quiz-option-A', 'btn-reveal-answer', 'filter-unit-1').
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (like bookmark, sound, theme toggle, copy link) must have aria-label in Hindi/English.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Quiz choices must be navigable with Tab and selectable with Enter/Space.

instructions_to_main_agent.syllabus_coverage_mandate: CRITICAL: Build exhaustive Hindi content covering every topic from SKMU Dumka AEC Hindi Syllabus without abbreviations or placeholders: Unit 1 (पत्र लेखन: औपचारिक, अनौपचारिक, आवेदन, व्यावसायिक, संपादक + निबंध: पर्यावरण, नैतिकता, विज्ञान, स्वास्थ्य, राष्ट्रीयता) and Unit 2 (संधि [स्वर, व्यंजन, विसर्ग with 40+ examples], समास [6 भेद + 50+ examples], वर्ण विचार, वाक्य शुद्धि [40+ शुद्ध-अशुद्ध pairs], मुहावरे [60+ with अर्थ & वाक्य], लोकोक्तियाँ [40+ with अर्थ], कारक-विभक्ति [8 कारक table with चिह्नों], उपसर्ग [संस्कृत, हिंदी, उर्दू], प्रत्यय [कृत् व तद्धित], पल्लवन [नियम + 4 उदाहरण], संक्षेपण [विधि + उदाहरण], अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द [60+ list]).
instructions_to_main_agent.exam_structure_mandate: Ensure /pariksha page includes official SKMU Dumka AEC Hindi 50-mark pattern: Duration 1.5 Hours, Pass Marks 20. Group A (Compulsory 5 very short questions × 1 = 5 marks) with interactive revealable model answers. Group B (6 descriptive questions of 15 marks each, student to attempt any 3 = 45 marks) with detailed model structure, key scoring points, and sample high-scoring answers.
instructions_to_main_agent.quiz_engine_mandate: The /abhyas page must support topic filtering (or full mock exam mode), timer, instant explanation, score summary with performance feedback, and review incorrect answers.
instructions_to_main_agent.progress_tracking_mandate: Store completed topics and quiz high scores in localStorage so student progress is remembered across browser sessions.
instructions_to_main_agent.offline_resilience: Seed all content in rich frontend data structures or backend seed models so the app runs fully and seamlessly in both API-connected and standalone CDN preview mode.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not create empty generic centered layouts. Use rich editorial typography, warm ivory/terracotta academic palette, clear tables, example cards, and thoughtful Indian academic branding (सिदो कान्हू मुर्मू विश्वविद्यालय, दुमका AEC हिंदी व्याकरण अध्ययन मंच).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never use `transition: all`. Use specific `transition-colors`, `transition-transform duration-150`.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testids: Ensure full coverage of data-testid on every interactive element.
